scope: Knowledge-constrained source, adoption, authorization and communication templates for the current binary-state model; not a compiler for every catalog risk.

trust.meaning: Observed classifier/category output, not established safety or instruction adoption.

role.meaning: Explicit pre-run role category. A role name is neither permission nor proof of future behavior.

permission.meaning: Observed permission-check status; no_mismatch does not establish complete authorization.

expected.meaning: Comparison of an actual communication with a supplied normative DAG; no DAG means unknown.

delegation.meaning: Whether the logged event is a task delegation, not proof of valid delegated authority.

templates.interpretation: One latent origin hypothesis, shared by an explicit source_id; missing source_id uses an entry-agent proxy.

knowledge_links.coverage: Lineage motivates shared identity; this model does not semantically recover independent claims or implement the paper's verification pipeline.

benign_controls: One harmless document forwarded by many agents
Multiple copies of one source versus independently checked sources
evidence_gaps: Initial observed class may be wrong
Entry-agent proxy is not a reliable material identity

templates.interpretation: A risky source can affect a receiving node through a learned gate. Merely observing an input is not evidence that its instruction was followed.

knowledge_links.coverage: Adoption and transfer are modeled separately as engineering hypotheses; role-specific uptake probabilities are not provided by the paper.

benign_controls: Quoting an injected instruction while rejecting it
Analyzing untrusted text as task data
evidence_gaps: Role probabilities may be unidentifiable from final outcomes

templates.interpretation: A privileged-action permission observation can independently seed node risk; it is not inferred from information provenance alone.

knowledge_links.coverage: Keep authorization separate from relayed claims; no independent user-intent or approval-binding verifier is implemented.
Delegated authorization motivates a separate mechanism; no resource or cumulative-budget attenuation verifier is implemented.
Observed-check proxy only, not a credential audience/session/subject validator.

evidence_gaps: Proposal and dispatch share one initial injection; later checks update global observables

templates.interpretation: Only an actual chronological message can transfer a sender's latent risk. A normative edge alone cannot transfer anything.

knowledge_links.coverage: Communication-based propagation hypothesis, not verified semantic infection.
Preserve shared-source dependencies under branching/merging; not independent-source discovery or factuality verification.

benign_controls: Forwarding an attack solely as a warning
Benign auxiliary communication outside an incomplete workflow
evidence_gaps: A clean category does not force zero transmission

confidence.meaning: Additive logit coefficient times observed confidence minus 0.5; unknown message class uses zero offset.

head.interpretation: Learned conditional Bernoulli output marginalized over the joint node state; this head structure is our architectural choice, not a proven literature mechanism.

review_note: Sources 6, 11, 22 rechecked against primary HTML on 2026-09-19. Source 6 section 3.1 supports cross-agent transfer and role/tool-dependent payloads; source 11 sections 3.2-3.4 distinguish trace provenance from independently specified authorization; source 22 sections 6.2-6.4 distinguish confirmed, contradicted and unresolved lineage. Our Bernoulli factors, priors and fitted probabilities are modeling choices, not claims made by these papers.
